choose.when:
select psp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, psp.AMOUNT registShare,
pp.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
psp.CDATE registDate from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID where IFNULL(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' and psp.CDATE = #{registDate,jdbcType=DATE} and psp.AMOUNT >0
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId}
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999'
and fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and psp.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE03} order by AMOUNT
choose.otherwise:
select deal.TRADE_ID tradeId, dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, dealAdd.REG_DATE registDate, dealAdd.REG_DATE_AMT registShare, deal.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, deal.INT_AMT tradeAmt,
pp.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
deal.SHARE_AMT qty
from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealAdd on deal.TRADE_ID = dealAdd.TRADE_ID
from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealAdd on deal.TRADE_ID = dealAdd.TRADE_ID
left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} and deal.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
and IFNULL(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null'
